messages.author: Tuula Tarkastaja
messages.text: Hi Risto, TRN-052 dropped off monitoring about twenty minutes ago and I'm on my way there. Anything I should check first?

messages.author: Risto Ristikko
messages.text: For TRN-052 I'd look at the feed breaker in the DC panel before you start on the unit itself. A drop like that is most often a breaker tripped by a short spike. Reset it once. If it trips a second time don't reset again, that probably means a real fault downstream, so call me first.
